scope.visitsMetric: Estimated visits, not unique visitors or page views

limitations: Website Content requires a custom plan; all-channel top pages unavailable.
N/A means no estimate at selected scope, not zero visits.
Small/new domains have sparse and sometimes inconsistent estimates across reports.
Multi-game whole-domain totals do not represent AION 2 traffic.
Landing rows are a selected top-10 transcription per domain, not a complete export; some tables were reviewed only on the first 100 rows.
URL query variants retained as observed; not independent page topics and not blindly aggregated.
Top keywords are raw report labels and may be misspelled; no changes were made to keywords.json.
As-of date excludes Oct 05 onward; cannot infer current post-Oct04 traffic trend.
